IRS990.Desc: HIGHER EDUCATION: LOYOLA UNIVERSITY CHICAGO EDUCATED APPROXIMATELY 12,500 UNDERGRADUATE & 4,800 GRADUATE & PROFESSIONAL STUDENTS FOR THE FALL 2024 TERM. LOYOLA STRIVES TO DELIVER THE PREMIER UNDERGRADUATE EDUCATIONAL EXPERIENCE IN CHICAGO, CHARACTERIZED BY A TRANSFORMATIVE EXPERIENCE IN THE JESUIT TRADITION & A COMMITMENT TO THE UNDERSERVED. THE QUINLAN SCHOOL OF BUSINESS CONTINUES TO BE RANKED AS THE NUMBER 1 UNDERGRADATE BUSINESS PROGRAM IN CHCAGO BY U.S. NEWS & WORLD REPORT RANKINGS. SIMILARLY, THE MARCELLA NIEHOFF SCHOOL OF NURSING BACHELOR OF SCIENCE PROGRAM IS RANKED IN THE TOP 2 PERCENT OF UNDERGRADUATE NURSING PROGRAMS NATIONWIDE. At the graduate and professional levels, Loyola delivers a high-quality education defined by excellence, innovation, justice, and leadership. The university comprises 13 schools and colleges, along with numerous institutes and centers.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: HIGHER EDUCATION AUXILIARY SERVICES: LOYOLA UNIVERSITY CHICAGO PROVIDES VARIOUS SERVICES AND AMENITIES THAT STRENGTHEN AND ENHANCE THE LOYOLA STUDENT, FACULTY, AND STAFF EXPERIENCE. THESE SERVICES INCLUDE HOUSING, FOOD SERVICE, AND RECREATIONAL FACILITIES.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: RESEARCH: LOYOLA UNIVERSITY CHICAGO ENGAGES IN EXTERNALLY FUNDED RESEARCH PROJECTS AIMED AT SOLVING CONTEMPORARY, SOCIETAL CHALLENGES, WITH THE GOAL OF CREATING A BETTER AND MORE JUST TOMORROW. THE RESEARCH IS CONDUCTED IN EACH OF LOYOLA'S THREE CHICAGO-AREA CAMPUSES (HEALTH SCIENCE CAMPUS, WATER TOWER CAMPUS, AND LAKESHORE CAMPUS) AND SERVES TO ADVANCE KNOWLEDGE WHILE ALSO PROVIDING TRAINING OPPORTUNITIES TO STUDENTS IN THE RESEARCH PROCESS. LOYOLA'S TOTAL RESEARCH EXPENDITURES HAVE GROWN STEADILY RESULTING IN LOYOLA ATTAINING THE HIGHEST RESEARCH CLASSIFICATION, RESEARCH 1 (R1) BY THE AMERICAN COUNCIL ON EDUCATION AND THE CARNEGIE FOUNDATION DURING FISCAL YEAR 2025.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Schedule D, Part III, Line 4 DESCRIPTION AND PURPOSE OF ORGANIZATION'S ART COLLECTIONS
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: As a museum with an interest in education and educational programming, the Loyola University Museum of Art (LUMA) reflects the University's Jesuit mission and is dedicated to helping men and women of all creeds explore the roots of their own faith and spiritual quest. LUMA is dedicated to exploring, promoting, and understanding art and artistic expression that attempts to illuminate the enduring spiritual questions and concerns of all cultures and societies. All of LUMA's collections are used as a part of our educational curriculum as well as our Fine & Performing Arts and Public History Programs. Martin D'Arcy, S.J. Collection The Museum interprets and displays the University's medieval and renaissance collection, known as the Martin D'Arcy, S.J. Collection. The D'Arcy is one of the Midwest's finest collections of Medieval, Renaissance, and Baroque art. It is particularly noted for its diverse holdings of three-dimensional objects that epitomize both the religious and secular aspects of European life. Devotional ivories, painted sculptures, and enameled liturgical objects feature among its medieval highlights; in covering the Renaissance, the D'Arcy is especially strong in objects commissioned to celebrate familial events such as marriage and childbirth. Among its Baroque pieces are Christ Among the Doctors by Matthias Stomer, a Dutch-born follower of Caravaggio, and intricate pieces of metalwork and woodwork, such as a collector's chest by Wenzel Jamnitzer, the leading German goldsmith of this period, and The Flagellation by Alessandro Algardi. The James and Emilia Govan Crche Collection LUMA's annual holiday exhibition, Art and Faith of the Crche: The Collection of James and Emilia Govan, continues each year with over 100 nativity scenes. These works represent only a small part of the Govans' gift, which was donated from 2009 to 2017. The first crche the Govans brought into their home came from Italy and was a gift from Jim to his wife Emilia. This present piqued an interest in crches and sparked a passion for collecting. When people learned of the Govans' interest, family and friends began to add to the collection. Over the course of almost forty years, the Govans amassed over 600 crches, representing over 100 countries. Many are unique in depicting the nativity story and incorporate elements, such as architecture, clothing, animals, gifts, and materials, that are particular to the artist's native country. Sr. Jean Dolores Schmidt, BVM Gallery A permanent exhibition honoring Sister Jean Dolores Schmidt, a beloved figure who touched the hearts of many through her unwavering faith, dedication, and spirit. This exhibition celebrates Sister Jean's remarkable life and profound impact on Loyola University Chicago and the wider community. Via a collection of personal artifacts, awards, and memorabilia, visitors will journey through her decades of service, her role as chaplain of the Loyola Ramblers, and her inspiring contributions to education and social justice. This tribute to Sister Jean reflects the values she embodies - community, resilience, and love.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Schedule D, Part II, Line 9 Conservation easements financial reporting
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: SCHEDULE D, PART II, LINES 5, 6, 7 AND 9 THE UNIVERSITY HAS TWO PROPERTIES LISTED ON THE NATIONAL REGISTER OF HISTORIC PLACES: THE MUNDELEIN CENTER AND THE EMIL BACH HOUSE WHICH WAS DONATED TO THE UNIVERSITY DURING FISCAL YEAR 2025. THE UNIVERSITY HAS FIVE PROPERTIES THAT ARE DESIGNATED AS CHICAGO LANDMARKS: THE MADONNA DELLA STRADA CHAPEL, LEWIS TOWERS, THE MUNDELEIN CENTER, BURROWES HALL AND PIPER HALL. THERE IS NO SPECIFIC WRITTEN POLICY REGARDING THE PERIODIC MONITORING, INSPECTION, VIOLATIONS, AND ENFORCEMENT OF THE CONSERVATION EASEMENTS HELD BY THE UNIVERSITY. HOWEVER, THE OFFICE OF THE GENERAL COUNSEL AND THE UNIVERSITY'S FACILITIES DEPARTMENT ARE AWARE OF THE REGULATIONS AND RESTRICTIONS ATTACHED TO THESE BUILDINGS, AS DICTATED BY THE NATIONAL REGISTER OF HISTORIC PLACES, THE NATIONAL PARK SERVICE, AND THE COMMISSION ON CHICAGO LANDMARKS. AS SUCH, BEFORE ANY CHANGES, MODIFICATIONS OR RENOVATIONS ARE MADE TO THESE STRUCTURES, THE APPROPRIATE RULES AND REGULATIONS ARE REVIEWED AND FOLLOWED. ADDITIONALLY, THE CONSERVATION EASEMENTS RELATED TO THE AFOREMENTIONED BUILDINGS ARE NOT REPORTED IN EITHER THE BALANCE SHEET OR THE REVENUE AND EXPENSE STATEMENT OF THE UNIVERSITY, AS THERE IS NO BOOK VALUE TO THOSE EASEMENTS. THEY ARE SOLELY MEASURES IN PLACES TO PROTECT THE HISTORICAL INTEGRITY OF THE BUILDINGS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Schedule J, Part I, Line 1a Travel for companions

THE COST OF THE TRAVEL WAS NOT CONSIDERED TAXABLE COMPENSATION TO THE EMPLOYEE. UNIVERSITY FUNDED EXPENSES FOR SPOUSES ARE TAXABLE COMPENSATION TO THE EMPLOYEE UNLESS THERE IS DOCUMENTED "BONA FIDE BUSINESS PURPOSE" FOR THE SPOUSE'S TRAVEL. UNDER LIMITED CIRCUMSTANCES, THE UNIVERSITY MAY APPROVE EXPENSES FOR AN EMPLOYEE'S SPOUSE. GENERALLY, THESE SITUATIONS ARE RELATED TO ALUMNI OR DONOR EVENTS WHERE DIRECT UNIVERSITY BENEFIT IS DERIVED FROM THE ATTENDANCE OF THE SPOUSE. IF A BONA FIDE BUSINESS PURPOSE DOES NOT EXIST, ANY AMOUNTS REIMBURSED OR PAID DIRECTLY FOR SPOUSAL EXPENSES ARE INCLUDED IN THE TAXABLE WAGES OF THE EMPLOYEE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Line 11b Review of form 990 by governing body
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE TAX MANAGER WORKS WITH A PUBLIC ACCOUNTING FIRM TO COMPLETE A DRAFT FORM 990. THIS IS THEN REVIEWED IN DETAIL BY THE ASSISTANT VICE PRESIDENT TAX AND COMPLIANCE, CONTROLLER AND THE ACCOUNTING FIRM'S ENGAGEMENT MANAGEMENT TEAM. THE DRAFT FORM IS THEN REVIEWED BY THE SENIOR VICE PRESIDENT AND CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER. ONCE A FINAL DRAFT VERSION OF THE FORM 990 HAS BEEN PRODUCED, IT IS THEN REVIEWED BY THE AUDIT COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES. THE FINAL COMPLETE VERSION OF THE FORM 990 IS THEN DISTRIBUTED VIA THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES SECURE WEBSITE TO ALL THE VOTING MEMBERS OF THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES PRIOR TO ITS FILING.

FORM 990, PART VI, LINE 15 15A & 15B - PROCESS FOR DETERMINING EXECUTIVE COMPENSATION
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: INDEPENDENT REVIEW BY COMMITTEE OF BOARD OF TRUSTEES: EXECUTIVE COMPENSATION HAS BEEN DOCUMENTED AND DISCUSSED AT LEAST ANNUALLY AT A COMPENSATION COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES. THE HUMAN RESOURCES DEPARTMENT OF THE UNIVERSITY PREPARES COMPARATIVE AND HISTORICAL INFORMATION FOR THE COMMITTEE TO REVIEW FOR EACH OF THE FOLLOWING POSITIONS: PRESIDENT, PROVOST, SVPS, VICE PRESIDENTS, AND SELECT OTHERS. CONDUCT ANNUAL MARKET BENCHMARKING: THE INFORMATION PROVIDED INCLUDES A SALARY HISTORY, AN ANNUAL TOTAL COMPENSATION TALLY SHEET, A DETAILED COMPARISON OF COMPENSATION TO OTHER PEER INSTITUTIONS INCLUDING MEMBERS OF THE ASSOCIATION OF JESUIT COLLEGES AND UNIVERSITIES (AJCU) AS WELL AS OTHER DOCTORAL INSTITUTIONS OF COMPARABLE SIZE. MOST OF THE COMPENSATION DATA COMES FROM THE COLLEGE AND UNIVERSITY PROFESSIONAL ASSOCIATION - HUMAN RESOURCES (CUPA-HR) ANNUAL SALARY SURVEY. ASSESS ORGANIZATIONAL PERFORMANCE: PRIOR TO THE MEETING, THE CHAIR OF THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES REVIEWS THE COMPENSATION DATA, ASSESSES PERFORMANCE, AND PROPOSES COMPENSATION FOR THE PRESIDENT. PRIOR TO THE MEETING, THE PRESIDENT REVIEWS THE COMPENSATION DATA OF THE OTHER EXECUTIVES, ASSESSES PERFORMANCE, AND PROPOSES COMPENSATION FOR THE EXECUTIVES. COMPENSATION PACKAGE APPROVAL: THESE PROPOSALS, ALONG WITH THE COMPARABILITY DATA, ARE THEN REVIEWED, DISCUSSED AND APPROVED AT THE COMPENSATION COMMITTEE MEETING. ADDITIONALLY, A SUMMARY REPORT OF THIS DATA AND COMPENSATION DECISIONS WILL BE MADE AVAILABLE TO THE FULL BOARD OF TRUSTEES. HR PROVIDES TRANSPARENCY AND COMMUNICATES WITH STAKEHOLDERS: THE HUMAN RESOURCES DEPARTMENT DOCUMENTS ALL OF THE APPROVALS AND DECISIONS MADE DURING COMPENSATION COMMITTEE MEETINGS, RETAINS A COPY OF REPORTS IN ITS FILES, AND PROCESSES ANY AND ALL CHANGES.
